rules.chronology: A detected grammar feature is allowed only when an evidence-backed introduction point for the same textbook is at or before the passage subunit. Exact earlier-grade introductions carry forward automatically within the same textbook; future units never authorize earlier passages.
rules.priorGradeCarryForward: Only an exact evidence-backed boundary from an earlier grade may carry forward. Program/unit-only evidence remains unresolved and cannot authorize later-grade occurrences.
rules.morphology: Known vocabulary base forms do not authorize an inflected form unless the form also passes grammar chronology; canonical lexical -ing nouns explicitly registered as nouns are not gerund grammar occurrences.
rules.existingFlags: Per-unit audit flags, grammar labels, or previous PASS reports are not sufficient evidence for this final gate.
rules.falsePositiveCleanup: Bounded structural false positives and canonical-v7 lexical -ing nouns are removed before chronology counts without widening any grammar boundary.
rules.canonicalV7Supplement: Canonical v7 exact textbook/grade/subunit rows and direct official 2025 part evidence may supply bounded evidence. Conservative later app boundaries are permitted only when they cannot authorize an earlier passage than the source introduction.
rules.passCondition: Every remaining detected feature occurrence in all 168 passages and A/B English fields must resolve to an introduction point at or before the exact section; unresolved or future occurrences fail closed.

next: Run authoritative 168-passage audit. Remaining true future grammar must be synchronized in text; do not widen evidence.
